title: Burst-latency guard is residential-only: content_host's legal burst-2 (ceiling 2) self-breaches streaming's 300 ms tolerance on a narrow access — unanalyzed and unpinned
evidence: spec:174-175: 'content_host ≈ **1.33 pkts/tick long-run (40 u/s)** — 50% of its 80 u/s (burst ≤ 2/tick via its type-relative ceiling 2)' · spec:144-146: 'Residential: ceiling 1 → **no burst** — the pre-5.10 latency constraint (Perkins r2 W5: a burst-2 through the 5 u/s access serializes the 2nd packet in 12 ticks = 600 ms > email's `latency_tol_ms` 500) is avoided by construction.' · data/demand.json era 3: '"class_id": "streaming", "source_role": "content_host"' · data/packet_types.json: '"latency_tol_ms": 300' (streaming) · data/node_types.json: '"throughput_units": 80' (content_host). 2×30 u through a 5 u/s narrow = 2nd packet at 12 ticks = 600 ms > 300 ms; even post-5.10 narrow 8 u/s gives 400 ms.
detail: The W5 latency guard holds only for residential ceiling 1; content_host is the streaming/surge source with legal burst 2, and W10's at-cap assertion is 'a single residential sourcing at cap' — no pin or canon text covers the ceiling>1 burst.
recommended_fix: Extend the W5 analysis to every ceiling>1 type (or gate burst by the access link's serialization within the class tolerance) and widen W10's transit assertion to a content_host-at-cap scenario.

title: Accumulator initial value and newly-live-terminal lifecycle unspecified — run start, growth-spawned terminals (every 120 ticks), and slot growth beside a gen-rebuilt lane_caps
evidence: spec:133-137: '**Credit:** `spawn_credit_milli[terminal_slot]` — integer milli-packets; a source spawn costs **1000**; a terminal is **pickable only while `credit_milli >= 1000`** … **Accrual:** `accrue_milli = cap_fraction_permille × throughput_units ÷ packet_bandwidth` (integer division, ODN-10) each tick, per live terminal' — no initial value anywhere · spec:144-146: 'lives in **Flow_State beside `lane_caps`** … **updated in place**' · core/flow.odin:598-613: 'if state.topology.gen != f.lane_caps_gen { … rebuild … }' (lane_caps IS rebuilt on gen change; credit must not be) · core/growth.odin:60: 'GROWTH_INTERVAL_TICKS :: u64(120)'.
detail: The minion must invent the initial credit (0 adds a ~12-tick dead window per grown terminal; MAX grants an immediate burst) — a choice that shifts the golden spawn stream and the W9 surge-count pin; array-growth semantics on topology change are also unstated.
recommended_fix: Specify: terminal starts accruing from 0 credit the tick it becomes live (or MAX at founding); slots append on growth, dead slots retain stale credit unread; neither rebuilds on gen.

title: Empty-eligible-set tick: '(or waits)' names no mechanism and skipped volume is unobservable — not a demand event, no counter, no tag
evidence: spec:116-118: 'Then the capped terminal is **ineligible for source picks** and the volume lands on other terminals (or waits)' — no wait mechanism exists in the design (volume is per-tick `effective_volume`; the accumulator gates picks; nothing queues) · spec:190-192: 'a capped spawn is **skipped before `flow_try_spawn`** — it is NOT a demand event (never reaches `sla_count_demand`)' · core/flow.odin:646: 'for k in 0..<vol'.
detail: When every eligible terminal is credit-starved for a tick, the volume silently vanishes — indistinguishable from 'waits'; the systematic case is guarded by the re-tune + W9, transient ticks are invisible to every named pin.
recommended_fix: Replace '(or waits)' with the actual semantics (per-tick skip, volume not deferred, not a demand event) and name whether the skip consumes an rng draw.

title: Group-bias draw's degenerate branches still unspecified: no existing cluster member (first growth spawn) and a cluster at its 3–8 group-size cap
evidence: spec:234-235: 'a spawned terminal is drawn near an existing cluster member (a group radius + a group-size cap), so clusters actually concentrate' — undefined when no member exists (first spawn) or the cluster is full (3–8 cap); both branches are reachable every run · spec:239: 'Proposed starting shape: 3–8 terminals per group' — no fallback stated.
detail: Still present since round 2: card 5.12's minion must invent the fallback semantics for the two most common draw states (empty map, full cluster).
recommended_fix: One sentence in Thread 3 / card 5.12: the first terminal founds a group; a full cluster falls back to the unbiased E31 draw (or founds a new group).

title: 'burst allowance' in the quantitative W9/W10 pins is a named but unbound parameter — the upper-bound pins' tightness is implementer-chosen
evidence: spec:192-194: 'per-terminal spawns ≤ cap × window + burst allowance and credit ≤ MAX_CREDIT; W10 pins the same rate envelope on the at-cap scenario (spawns ≤ ceil(cap × W) + burst allowance over a W-tick window on a known seed)' — 'burst allowance' is never valued or derived; a generous choice (e.g. ≥ W × cap) makes the upper bound vacuous, reopening the r2 W6 hole for the bound direction.
detail: The pins are declared QUANTITATIVE but their allowance term is free; the tight bound is derivable (spawns ≤ floor((MAX_CREDIT_MILLI + W × accrue_milli) ÷ 1000)) yet not stated.
recommended_fix: Bind the allowance explicitly: spawns over W ticks ≤ floor((MAX_CREDIT_MILLI(type) + W × accrue_milli) ÷ 1000), stated in card 5.9's pins.
